verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local API inside the desktop app, plus a headless CLI server mode for automation. A developer portal publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi-v2.yaml) with full schemas, error responses, dated API versions, and a changelog, and it also offers an official MCP server and an agents toolkit built on that API. The 404s from the OpenAPI probe were on doc.anytype.io, while the spec lives on developers.anytype.io, so they are not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a written deprecation policy and try-it console, and a stable v2 (currently pre-release); the API is also localhost-only, requiring the desktop app or headless CLI.
